newsitem.title: USA: Vical wins patent for DNA injection method.
newsitem.headline: Vical wins patent for DNA injection method.

text.p: Vical Inc said on Thursday it has won a U.S. patent for its its method of immunization through direct injection of DNA sequences, or genes, into muscle or skin.
In a statement, Vical said its scientists and their collaborators discovered cells in some tissues can take up DNA directly and produce proteins encoded by DNA.
When applied as a vaccine, this new technology can induce cellular and antibody protective immunity, Vical said.
Vical shares were up one at 17-1/2 by mid-morning.
